Shanghai, June 15th, 1931.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. REG.

Dear Sir,

I called at your Offices on Feb. 25th, 1931 in
order to discuss an anonymous letter received by your depart-
ment in which the malicious and fantastic accusation that I was
poisoning my wife was made. Referring to the letter in
question, I shall deem it a favour if you will be so kind as to
advise me (1) whether there is any liklihood of the scoundrel or
scoundrels who wrote it being traced and (2) the Police would be
willing to co-operate in private enquiries I intend to make.

It may interest you to know that I have, after
strenuous efforts, obtained a deed of separation from Mrs. Villas
on April 28th, 1931.

Yours faithfully,
（签名）

（批：Refd Office file
Recd & attached
15/6 R. C. Alers Esq.
C. I. D.

先生：

我于1931年2月25日曾造访贵办公室，旨在讨论贵部门收到的一封匿名信，信中对我提出了恶毒且荒谬的指控，称我正在毒害我的妻子。关于该信，若蒙告知 (1) 是否有希望追踪到撰写此信的无赖，以及 (2) 警方是否愿意配合我打算进行的私下调查，我将不胜感激。

或许您会有兴趣知道，经过艰苦努力，我已于1931年4月28日从维拉斯夫人（Mrs. Villas）处获得了分居契约。

此致
敬礼
（签名）

（批注：转办公室档案
已收悉并附后
6月15日 R. C. Alers 先生
刑事侦缉处
上海公共租界工部局。）

Dear Mr. Ward,

nothing to worry about.

Yours truly,

H.L. Ward Esquire,
Platt & Co.,
23 Peking Road.

C. & S. D. REC.
No. S. B. D. 1963.
ate 27 - 2 - 31.
25, Peking Road.
Shanghai, February 20th, 1931.

Dear Sir,

In consequence of an anonymous letter received
by the Criminal Investigation Department towards the end of last
month, Police inquiries were instituted into a case of alleged
poisoning by me of my wife, Nellie Villas. As a result of the
above, the Police are perfectly satisfied that this accusation
is both groundless and malicious. In this connection, I en-
close a copy of a certificate dated the 10th instant, issued, at
my request, by Dr. Kastein, which is a further proof of the ab-
surdity of the allegation.

Mrs. Villas is of a peculiar mentality, and possibly
aggravated by her ailment, she had often expressed a desire, should
her case prove incurable, to do away with herself. Under the
circumstances, I am writing to you to place on record that,
notwithstanding the fact that we are at present under the same
roof, I shall not be answerable for any rash acts on her part.

Yours faithfully,
[Signature]

The Capt. Superintendent.
Shanghai Municipal Police.
[Signature]

1931年2月20日。

先生：

鉴于刑事侦缉处在上月底收到一封匿名信，警方针对我被指控毒害妻子 Nellie Villas 一案展开了调查。基于上述调查，警方完全确信该指控既无根据又属恶意。就此，随函附上应我请求由 Kastein 医生于本月10日出具的证明书副本，这进一步证明了该指控的荒谬性。

Vilas 夫人心智特异，加之病情可能加剧了这种情况，她曾多次表示，若其病例证明无法治愈，她将自杀。在此情况下，我致函阁下备案：尽管我们目前同住一个屋檐下，但我对她任何鲁莽行为概不负责。

此致
敬礼
[签名]

巡官长。
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
[签名]
27/2

CONTINUATION
SHEET

Allegations in anonymous letter against
one George Villa.

Sir,

Further to my report of 27th instant.

Mr. Tizon reported to me on the evening of 28/1/31
the result of his inquiries:-

On 28/1/31 he went to 92-a Scott Road ostensibly
on a friendly visit to Mrs. Villas whom he knows as an
old acquaintance. (She is Cantonese and married to Villa
about ten years and is about 40 years old), she was in
bed when he called and appeared very ill. After some
ordinary conversation she made a long rambling statement,
the gist of which was:-

That her husband for the past 18 months has been
keeping company with a Miss Lespinasse who is his sister-
in-law (sister of his brother's, Jose R. Villas, 684 Rue
Lafayette, wife) and to marry her he wished the present
wife to die. That a Madame Soo, fortune teller, came to
the house (92-a) in July last year to "apply black magic
against her life", and that the husband had been trying
Chinese superstitious practices to get rid of her,
including the use of certain Chinese drugs which causes
lethargic sleep etc. That she had previously had been
attended by Dr. Martelliere (No. 215 Sassoon Building) and
Dr. Schwarzenberg (1 Kiukiang Road) and was now being
attended by Dr. Kastien (1 Kiukiang Road) and had informed
the latter to hold a post-mortem on her when she died.
That if he (Tizon) doubted her, for him to see a Mrs.
Remedios or a Mrs. Tomlin (addresses unknown); She denied
writing the letter signed "outcry".

According to Tizon the woman appeared quite normal
when speaking to him.

续页

针对 George Villa 的匿名信中的指控。

先生：

继我本月27日的报告之后。

Tizon 先生于31年1月28日晚向我汇报了他的调查结果：-

31年1月28日，他前往斯科特路92-a号，名义上是友好拜访他认识的老熟人维拉斯夫人。（她是广东人，嫁给 Villa 约十年，现年约40岁），他到访时她正卧病在床，看起来病得很重。经过一番寻常交谈后，她发表了一番冗长且漫无边际的陈述，其要点如下：-

她的丈夫在过去18个月里一直与其嫂妹（即其兄弟 Jose R. Villas 的妻子之姐妹，住址为拉斐特路684号）Lespinasse 小姐保持关系，为了娶她，丈夫希望现任妻子死去。去年七月，一位姓苏的算命女士来到家中（92-a号）“施黑巫术害她性命”，并且丈夫一直试图通过中国迷信手段摆脱她，包括使用某些导致嗜睡等症状的中国药物。她此前曾由 Martelliere 医生（沙逊大厦215号）和 Schwarzenberg 医生（九江路1号）诊治，现在则由 Kastien 医生（九江路1号）诊治，并已告知后者在她死后进行尸检。如果他（Tizon）怀疑她，可以去找 Remedios 夫人或 Tomlin 夫人（地址不详）；她否认写过署名为“outcry”的信件。

据 Tizon 称，该女子在与他交谈时表现完全正常。

CONTINUATION
SHEET

-2-

Certain friends of the Villas family say that the
woman's story of the alleged poisoning is common knowledge
among them and they do not take it seriously. They say
Mrs. Villas is of a harsh, money-grabbing and irascible
character.

The husband George Villas is a clerk in the office
of Messrs. Platt & Co., 23 Peking Road, and is given a
high character by his friends.

On 29/1/31 I interviewed Dr. Kastien at 1 Kiukiang
Road. He informed me Mrs. Villas had told him the same
story, but that he could not find any signs or symtoms of
poisoning, and that she was really suffering from a very
bad heart and he did not expect her to live long. The
Doctor also informed me that he analysed a Chinese medicine
which she gave him, and which she said was being put in her
food. He found it mostly sulphur and not at all dangerous
unless an abnormally large quantity was taken at one time.
As to her request to him for a post-mortem when she died,
the Dr. said he would like to do so for the purpose of
examing her heart which was one of the worst he had
experienced.

The address 82-A Scott Road is situated about 200
yards off later road on a small road called S-tuh Road not
policed by us, and the number is not S.M.C. The house is
large and in its own grounds and is Villas' own property.
Villas is a Spanish subject which fact I have informed the
U. S. District Attorney.

Whilst the Doctor's statement disposes of the
allegation of attempt poisoning, the affair is not being
lost sight of in case the writer of the letter may be
traced (assuming the wife did not do so).

续页

-2-

Villas 家族的某些朋友表示，该女子关于所谓投毒的故事在他们中间已是众所周知，但他们并不当真。他们说维拉斯夫人性格严厉、贪财且易怒。

丈夫 George Villa 是北京路23号 Platt & Co. 公司的职员，朋友们对他的评价很高。

31年1月29日，我在九江路1号采访了 Kastien 医生。他告诉我，维拉斯夫人向他讲述了同样的故事，但他未发现任何中毒的迹象或症状，而且她确实患有严重的心脏病，他预计她活不了多久。医生还告诉我，他分析了她给他的一种中药，她说这种药被放进了她的食物中。他发现其中主要是硫磺，除非一次性服用异常大的剂量，否则完全没有危险。至于她请求在他死后进行尸检，医生说他也希望能这样做，目的是检查她的心脏，那是他见过的最糟糕的心脏之一。

斯科特路82-A号（译注：原文此处写为82-A，前文为92-a，依原文翻译）位于稍远的一条名为 S-tuh 路的小路上，距离主路约200码，不在我们的管辖范围内，该门牌号也不属于上海公共租界工部局。这所房子很大，拥有独立院落，是 Villas 的私有财产。Villas 是西班牙籍公民，我已将此事实告知美国地方检察官。

虽然医生的陈述排除了企图投毒的指控，但我们并未忽视此事，以防能追踪到信件作者（假设并非妻子所为）。

S. B. D. 1963.
Allegations in anonymous letter against one
George Villa, Filipino, 92-A Scott Road.
Sir,
Reference attached letter signed "outcry" I
interviewed Dr. Sellet, U.S. District Attorney and showed
him the letter on 27/1/31. He informed me that the name
George Villa was not on their register for 1930, but even
so, the American authorities took jurisdiction over
Filipinos.
Discussing the attached letter with me the District
Attorney agreed that direct inquiries at 92-a Scott Road
at present might lead nowhere and there appeared no
urgency. The letter may only be the result of jealousy
(the writing appears feminine).
I informed the U.S. District Attorney that I was
having discreet inquiries made re. Villa and the contents
of the letter, and he (District Attorney) then instructed
a Mr. Samone (Filipino attached to the U.S. Court) to do
likewise and report to him.
I obtained Supt. Robertson's (Special Branch)
permission for Clercial Assistant Tizon to make discreet
inquiries.
Mr. Tizon informed me he knew George Villa, (who
has long residence in Shanghai,) but he had not heard any
rumours such as contained in the letter attached. Villa
has a brother in the Special Police.
Mr. Tizon is to inform me immediately if he finds
there is any truth in the letter; he will give me definite
information on 29th instant. Meanwhile discreet investig-
ions are being made in the vicinity of 92-a Scott Road.
The U.S. District Attorney and I have arranged for
an exchange of the information obtained from our respective

S. B. D. 1963.
针对一名菲律宾人 George Villa 的匿名信中的指控，住址斯科特路92-A号。
先生，
参照附件中署名为“outcry”的信件，我于31年1月27日采访了美国地方检察官 Sellet 先生，并向他展示了该信件。他告知我，1930年的登记册中没有 George Villa 的名字，但即便如此，美国当局对菲律宾人拥有管辖权。
与我讨论附件中的信件时，地方检察官同意，目前在斯科特路92-a号进行直接调查可能毫无结果，且似乎并不紧急。这封信可能只是嫉妒的结果（笔迹看似女性）。
我告知美国地方检察官，我正在就 Villa 及信件内容进行谨慎调查，他（地方检察官）随即指示一名 Mr. Samone（隶属美国法院的菲律宾人）也进行同样调查并向他汇报。
我获得了 Robertson 巡官（特别科）的许可，让助理文员 Tizon 进行谨慎调查。
Tizon 先生告知我，他认识 George Villa（他在上海居住已久），但他从未听说过附件信件中所包含的任何谣言。Villa 有一个兄弟在特别警察队。
如果 Tizon 先生发现信件内容有任何真实性，他将立即通知我；他将于本月29日向我提供确切信息。与此同时，正在斯科特路92-a号附近进行谨慎调查。

Shanghai Municipal Police
Detective !

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. RECORDS
No. S. B. D. 1963.
date 27 - 1 - 31.）

It may be of interest for
you to know that a strange case
is happening in 92 A Scott Road.
It is very serious. A Filipino name
George Villa and his wife are
the residents of the above address.
They were married ten years ago.
The Filipino George Villa getting
tired of his wife and he became
interested in his brother's wife's sister,
is now attempting the life of his
wife. The wife is in a
very precarious position. She
got a very peculiar kind of
sickness — poisoning.
The wife may die any moment.
In case she died the husband
is responsible.

A new servant is
also suspicious

" Outery "

您可能会有兴趣知道，斯科特路92 A号发生了一起奇怪案件。
情况非常严重。一名名叫
George Villa 的菲律宾人及其妻子
居住在上述地址。
他们十年前结婚。
菲律宾人 George Villa 厌倦了
他的妻子，并对他兄弟的妻子的妹妹
产生了兴趣，现在正试图谋害
他妻子的性命。妻子处于
非常危险的境地。她
得了一种非常奇特的
病——中毒。
妻子随时可能死亡。
如果她死了，丈夫
负有责任。

一名新仆人
也很可疑

“ Outery ”
